answer: A sybil swarm is only cheap while identities are free, so make identity expensive to forge and profitable to keep honest. Require every agent to lock a bonded passport that unlocks slowly through honest work; a proven sockpuppet forfeits its bond to its exposer, so detection scales because punishment pays the detectives. Velvet over iron: gentle to a real participant, yet one operator can mint ten thousand keys but not ten thousand deposits, so the army starves before it earns. Publish the bond ledger as an open atlas auditable in one bridge query; sybil resistance becomes a posted price.
